issue.description:
ADR-005 is Accepted with no corresponding implementation bead. Add a ready_frontier check to `bead doctor` under the dependencies scope that warns when open issues carry an assignee (excluded from the ready frontier, silently unclaimable), names a bounded sample of the offending ids, and states the exact remedy (`bead update <id> --clear-assignee`). Advisory only: doctor never clears an assignee, not even under --repair. Tests: the check fires for open+assigned issues, stays silent for in_progress/deferred/closed and unassigned-open issues, --repair leaves assignment untouched, and output is clean when no offending issues exist. This is the documented fleet-wide starvation mode (583 stuck issues across 47 workspaces) that no current diagnostic surfaces.

---
Priority: P1
Created by: weave strand
